dataset.name: Cyber Task Horizons public traces
dataset.source_mode_confound: Human terminal-key capture vs Agent tool-call traces; labels and capture pathway are confounded.

evaluation.queries: Every trace in the held-out fold
evaluation.gallery: All other held-out traces from the same benchmark; no mode/source filtering or task aggregation; query itself excluded
evaluation.positive_proxy: Same benchmark and CTF task; this is not shared actor or campaign ground truth
evaluation.tie_rule: Expected metric under uniform random ordering inside score ties
evaluation.aggregation: Average queries within task, then tasks within benchmark, then equal-weight benchmarks
evaluation.pair_training: Balanced sampled pairs, labels derived only from same/different benchmark-task identity; no mode/source used to construct pairs
evaluation.pair_methods: Behavior ranker uses command cosine, action-bigram cosine, ProcGrep similarity, and command-length similarity; mode ranker adds pairwise agreement/gap from task-OOF mode scores.
evaluation.uncertainty: 5,000 paired bootstrap resamples of task-level outcomes, conditional on fitted folds; not a new independent test set

folds.candidate_rule: same benchmark, all test-fold traces, exclude query by trace_id; mode/source labels not used

robustness_mean_across_splits.interpretation: For each benchmark-task, first average its outcomes across alternate split seeds; task-cluster bootstrap then summarizes across tasks. This is split sensitivity, not independent replication.

interpretation_guard: Task retrieval is a proxy feasibility study. It cannot establish APT campaign/actor linkage or causal impact of LLM Agents.
